# Strata

> Strata is a knowledge system for AI coding agents: 131 files built around plain Markdown in git that give your coding agent a memory with status, provenance, and two dates on every entry. When a premise changes, everything built on it gets flagged. One-time $19.99, with a free 31-file sample.

## What it is

Strata is a plain-Markdown knowledge system that lives in your Git repo, next to the code. Every entry carries a status (settled, assumed, disproven), a source, and two dates: when it became true, and when it was recorded. Disproven entries are buried, not deleted, so they stay readable and cannot be quietly resurrected. When a premise changes, an invalidation sweep flags everything that depended on it.

## Who it is for

Coding agents that read and write files in a repo: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar tools. Nothing is tied to one vendor. There is no Strata service, no account, no sync, no dashboard.

## The four rules

- Status travels: an entry's standing rides into every context it is quoted in.
- Two clocks: when a thing became true and when you learned it are separate fields.
- Buried, not deleted: superseded and disproven entries stay on the record with validity closed.
- Not everything earns a layer: material from untrusted sources waits in an inbox until corroborated.

## How it differs

- RAG / vector memory retrieves by similarity and cannot tell a settled fact from a guess or a dead fact from a live one.
- Hosted memory APIs keep knowledge in the vendor's database, in a shape you do not control.
- A giant CLAUDE.md is one flat file of assertions with no provenance.
- Plain notes have no states: a note cannot say how well it is known.
- Strata compiles knowledge once into typed entries, then maintains it: status, provenance, invalidation sweeps, and procedures compiled into Agent Skills.

## What you get

131 files in one bundle for $19.99, one-time, no subscription: Remember (the working knowledge system, 14 typed categories), Trust (the governance layer), Act (the skills layer, six Agent Skills (three working, three example) with one-tap setup and home-install mode). 14-day, one-email, full refund. The free sample is the complete Remember core, 31 files, with a five-question mini self-test.
